{
  "dataset_name": "letter",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "pixel_density_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of on-pixels to bounding box area, measuring how densely filled the letter is. Normalized by max possible area.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Dense vs sparse letters differ systematically; linear SVM can use this as a smooth margin feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(onpix / (np.maximum(width * high, 1)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "aspect_ratio_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Width-to-height ratio of bounding box, normalized to [0,1] range. Captures horizontal vs vertical letter orientation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_geometry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aspect ratio is a smooth continuous feature that linearly separates wide vs tall letters.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(width / (np.maximum(width + high, 1)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "centroid_x_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Deviation of x-centroid from box center, normalized by width. Measures horizontal asymmetry of the letter.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "centroid_geometry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Asymmetric letters have distinctive centroid offsets; useful linear feature for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((x_bar - (x_box + width / 2.0)) / (np.maximum(width, 1)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "centroid_y_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Deviation of y-centroid from box center, normalized by height. Measures vertical asymmetry of the letter.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "centroid_geometry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Vertical centroid offset distinguishes letters with top-heavy vs bottom-heavy strokes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((y_bar - (y_box + high / 2.0)) / (np.maximum(high, 1)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_complexity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined horizontal and vertical edge count normalized by perimeter, measuring overall edge complexity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Complex letters with many edges score higher; smooth normalized score works well with linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((x_ege + y_ege) / (np.maximum(2.0 * (width + high), 1)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "variance_asymmetry",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between x-variance and y-variance of pixel distribution, normalized. Captures directional spread asymmetry.",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "moment_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Letters with horizontal vs vertical spread differ in this score; linear projection useful for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((x2bar - y2bar) / 15.0, -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cross_moment_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Cross-correlation moment xybar normalized to [0,1], capturing diagonal pixel distribution patterns.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "moment_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Cross-moment captures diagonal strokes; smooth normalized value aids linear SVM separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(xybar / 15.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_to_pixel_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of total edges to on-pixels, measuring edge density relative to filled area.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "High edge-to-pixel ratio indicates outline-heavy letters; useful continuous feature for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((x_ege + y_ege) / (np.maximum(onpix * 2.0, 1)), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "weighted_moment_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted combination of second-order moments x2ybr and xy2br normalized, capturing higher-order shape structure.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "moment_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite moment score provides smooth linear projection of shape complexity for SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((0.5 * x2ybr + 0.5 * xy2br) / 15.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "edge_direction_bias",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of x-edges to y-edges, log-transformed to linearize. Captures whether letter has more horizontal or vertical edges.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "edge_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Edge direction bias is a smooth continuous feature that linearly separates letters by stroke orientation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(x_ege) - np.log1p(y_ege), -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bounding_box_size_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-normalized bounding box area relative to maximum possible area, measuring overall letter size.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_geometry",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Letter size is a fundamental discriminating feature; log normalization provides smooth linear-friendly scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(width * high) / np.log1p(225.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "stroke_regularity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of stroke regularity based on consistency between edge counts and pixel variance. Score from 0 (irregular, high variance relative to edges) to 1 (regular, balanced edge-variance relationship). Computed as normalized inverse of absolute difference between edge-normalized score and variance-normalized score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "shape_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Stroke regularity captures structural consistency of letter forms; smooth [0,1] score integrates well with linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(1.0 - np.abs((x_ege + y_ege) / (np.maximum(x_ege + y_ege + 1.0, 1)) - (x2bar + y2bar) / (np.maximum(x2bar + y2bar + 1.0, 1))), 0.0, 1.0)"
    }
  ]
}
